description: This file defines the LifoSet class, a set implementation with stack-like behavior and capacity management, wrapping a LinkedList.

classes.name: LifoSet
classes.description: A set with stack-like behavior and capacity limit, backed by a LinkedList, supporting typical set and stack operations.

methods.name: LifoSet
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty set.

methods.name: LifoSet
methods.description: Constructor initializing the set with a specified maximum capacity.

methods.name: setCapactity
methods.description: Sets the maximum capacity of the set.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the set.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the set, maintaining capacity constraints.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the set elements.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the set is empty.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes an element onto the set (stack push).

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top element of the set (stack pop).

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the top element without removing it (stack peek).

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns the 1-based position of an element from the top of the stack.
